messages:
Ivy Park: Quick spike on axis/contextual hints for the console charts. Proposal: instead of burying unit settings in a menu, surface a micro-hint row beneath the axis on hover/focus that shows current unit, smoothing state, and an overflow control. Example: "Units: Auto · Smoothed · Overflow >= 10k (12)". Clickable pieces open small panels. Thoughts? Marco Silva: I like inline hints for discoverability. Concern: could become noisy on dense dashboards. Maybe show only the condensed hint by default and expand on hover or keyboard focus. Jules Tran: Accessibility: the hint row needs explicit keyboard targets and SR announcements. For example, when focus lands on the hint row, SR reads: "YAxis options. Units: Auto. Smoothed enabled. Overflow 12 items." Each clickable chunk should be a button with aria-haspopup for the panels. Erin O'Connor: Microcopy: prefer shorter micro-hints: "Units: Auto · Smoothed · Overflow: 12". For the overflow panel header: "Overflow values >= 10,000" and list top 5 points. Keep descriptions minimal. Ivy Park: UX behavior: hover/focus expands to a small popover anchored to the axis showing controls: unit select, smoothing slider (0-100), overflow threshold adjuster, and a reset link. Popover must not cover important chart content. Marco Silva: Implementation note: smoothing slider should update a preview only (client-side) and apply on confirm to avoid expensive recompute. Also for very large series run preview sampling not full recompute. Jules Tran: ARIA example for the hint row button group: ```
``` Erin O'Connor: Outlier UX: overflow list should show tiny sparkline and exact value, with an action to pin that value so it renders as a capped marker on the main chart. Pinned markers should be keyboard reachable and have aria-labels like "Pinned outlier 14,321 at 2025-03-01 14:12". Ivy Park: Color/accessibility: overflow chip should maintain contrast and include a subtle icon (e.g., \u25b2) to indicate compression. Also allow users to choose whether overflow values are capped or rendered in a separate lane. Marco Silva: Smoothing explanation tooltip copy: "Smoothing reduces noise for trend views. Preview updates are sampled; apply to fully recompute." Keep it short. Jules Tran: Keyboard interactions: Tab to jump into hint row, Enter to open popover, Esc to close, Arrow keys to move between controls inside. Announce changes after apply: "Smoothing set to 40". Provide focus trap inside popover for keyboard users. Erin O'Connor: Edge case: when multiple charts sync, changing units or smoothing should offer a small toast: "Change applies to this chart only. Hold Shift to apply to all visible charts." Make the modifier discoverable in the popover. Designbot: Uploaded figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/ui-axes/hint-row-popovers frame: axis/hint-row-v1 :sparkles: Ivy Park: Good progress. Decision to prototype: condensed hint row under axis that expands on hover/focus into a popover with unit selector, smoothing preview + apply, overflow list + pin action, and a reset. Accessibility: full SR announcements and keyboard trap. Action items: Marco prototype sampled preview and shift-to-sync toast; Jules write ARIA spec and keyboard testcases; Erin draft microcopy and overflow panel layout. Marco Silva: Will prototype sampling approach this week and mock perf numbers. Jules Tran: Drafting ARIA spec now, will attach to the ticket. Erin O'Connor: Microcopy ready by tomorrow, will comment on figma. Ivy Park: Thanks team, moving to design-implement ticket after prototypes are attached. :rocket:
